name: What is involved in converting a garage into a bedroom?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in converting a garage into a bedroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Converting a garage into a bedroom is a significant home addition project that integrates the existing structure into a new living space. This typically involves ensuring proper insulation, updating electrical and HVAC systems, installing new flooring, and finishing walls and ceilings to match the home's interior. AKN Design Group manages this entire residential design-build process, from initial design and layout planning to structural integration, interior finishes, and exterior tie-in work, ensuring a seamless and functional transformation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Converting a garage to a bedroom involves insulating, updating utilities, and finishing the space to match your home's interior, managed by our integrated design-build process.
